name: vornik-companion
description: Async-offload companion for Claude Code with project RAG memory + per-repo scoping (migration 75). Delegate reviews / audits / validations / research / bulk-ingest; recall + remember scoped to the current repo so one project's RAG can serve multiple repos without cross-pollution. SessionStart digest surfaces completed delegations and recent memory updates. /upload attaches local files to delegations as base64 INPUT artifacts without burning client tokens; /rag-ingest (0.4.2) is the dedicated bulk-ingest entry point for project RAG memory (supports directories + --tag). 0.4.5: hotfix — session-start.sh now emits the v2-style {hookSpecificOutput,hookEventName,additionalContext} JSON envelope so the digest renders in the Claude Code v2.1+ welcome banner. Pre-0.4.5 raw markdown reached the model's context but was silently dropped from the banner. 0.4.4 wired hooks.json; 0.4.5 makes the wired script speak the v2 protocol. 0.4.6: /rag-ingest gained an explicit per-file size cap (--max-file-bytes, default 512 KiB) + accurate docs after the companion-rag-ingest WORKFLOW was fixed to copy staged sources with run_shell (cp/cat) instead of re-emitting bytes via file_read→file_write — the latter silently failed on large files (260 KiB CHANGELOG). Companion swarm template now also ships the rag-ingester role. 0.4.7: repo-scope resolvers (session-start.sh + /upload + /rag-ingest) now fall back to the current folder basename when there's no git origin / not a git repo, instead of returning empty — an empty scope surfaced to the operator as context "none" and silently routed recall/remember/delegate project-wide. All three resolvers stay in lockstep. 0.4.8: delegate guidance hardened after the 2026-06-05 silent-skip incident — file paths in a delegate prompt are never uploaded; daemon-side require_input_artifacts now rejects artifact-less rag-ingest delegations, and the delegate command/skill docs steer to /rag-ingest + /upload. 0.4.9: /rag-ingest docs updated for the 2026-06-11 server-side rewrite — companion-rag-ingest is now DETERMINISTIC and agent-free: the workflow has no agent step and the executor ingests staged input artifacts directly by ID (ingest_input_artifacts), removing the weak rag-ingester LLM from the copy loop that repeatedly claimed produced_files it never wrote (the 'try a different tool' large-file ingest failures). File size and model quality no longer affect whether the copy lands. 0.4.10: companion-architectural-review workflow now reviews the STAGED input artifact as its source of truth and refuses to review project memory (RAG holds stale/multiple doc revisions → contradictory findings); /upload is documented as workflow-generic and the canonical doc-review path (`/upload companion-architectural-review "…" <file>`); the delegate skill + /review + /delegate docs steer clients to attach files via /upload for any file-bearing workflow rather than naming a path in a delegate prompt the agent container can't read. 0.5.0: BREAKING command rename — dropped the redundant vornik- prefix from plugin actions (/vornik-upload→/upload, /vornik-rag-ingest→/rag-ingest, skill vornik-delegate→delegate); the plugin namespace already conveys vornik-companion, so vornik-companion:vornik-upload was doubly redundant. Usage guidance strengthened to make companion-architectural-review the default MERGE GATE for non-trivial changes and design docs: commit, upload the diff (git diff base...branch > file) or design doc as a staged artifact via /upload, block on the verdict, fix every Critical/Important finding, re-review, then merge; single-quote /upload prompts with NO double-quotes or backticks (they break the bash wrapper); delegate long reviews/audits/research proactively at task start. 0.6.0: new /memory-correct command + memory_correct MCP tool — soft-refute a wrong/stale RAG fact (top hybrid-search matches flip to validation_status='refuted' and drop out of recall) and optionally store the correction as a verified chunk; the programmatic equivalent of the dispatcher's chat-side memory_correct, so a host LLM can make newer findings take precedence over superseded notes (requires a memory_write-scoped key). ALSO: /remember rewritten to the heredoc→file→json.dumps→POST pattern (same hardening /upload and /rag-ingest already use) so long notes with quotes/backticks/newlines/em-dashes land intact instead of being mangled or truncated by inline MCP tool-call serialization; /remember and /memory-correct both gained leading --scope/--class/--ttl (remember) and --max/--scope (memory-correct) flags. 0.7.0: /memory-correct + the memory_correct MCP tool gain a surgical by-id mode — pass one or more --chunk-id (chunk_ids[] over MCP, from a prior /recall) to refute exactly those chunks instead of the claim-search top matches. Needed because once an authoritative correction exists it out-ranks the stale chunk in a claim search, so claim-mode would demote the correction rather than the stale note; by-id targets the right chunk. wrong_claim and chunk_ids are now either-or. 0.8.0: knowledge-skill commands — /skill-propose, /skill-search, /skill-get, /skill-list, /skill-approve, /skill-reject wrap the new daemon-owned knowledge-skill MCP verbs (instructional SKILL.md-style know-how, distinct from SWARM-SKILL.md capability skills and from RAG memory). A proposed skill lands as a draft and only fires after an operator with a skill_admin key approves it; approved skills are served to swarm roles + every companion client. Gated by new per-key caps: skill_read (search/get/list), skill_write (propose), skill_admin (approve/reject) — grant via `vornikctl companion grant --skill-read/--skill-write/--skill-admin/--skill-all`. 0.9.0: knowledge-skill auto-authoring — the SessionStart hook now plants a directive telling the model to capture durable, reusable, project-relevant procedures it works out during the session as DRAFT skills via skill_propose (dedupe via skill_search first; drafts need operator approval before they activate). Vornik never sees the transcript — only the resulting skill_propose call. Pairs with the existing /skill-* commands and the maturity engine (usage-driven promote/decay of approved skills). 0.10.0: cross-project (global) skills — /skill-set-global <id> [global|project] and a `global` arg on /skill-propose flip a skill's reach so an approved skill injects into EVERY project's roles (not just its home project) — the way a procedure captured in your companion project reaches the janka/assistant autonomy roles. Both are skill_admin-gated and project-checked; global drafts are labelled 'affects ALL projects' on every review surface (Telegram/UI). Operator equivalents: `vornikctl knowledge set-global/set-project` and the Admin → Skills inbox buttons. 0.11.0: RAG-first default — the SessionStart hook now plants a directive telling the assistant to `recall` BEFORE reading code on design/architecture/roadmap/"how does X work" questions (and bug symptoms that look like a known incident), treating the design/spec/decision-class LLDs in project memory as the authoritative design record and reading code only to verify a named symbol still matches. The rule used to live only in the operator's per-user CLAUDE.md, so it didn't ship with the plugin or help other operators. It is a PREFERENCE (trivial literal grep/cat lookups skip it) with a class-scoped trust boundary (research/incident/companion notes are hypotheses, not fact — so a poisoned chunk from a failed task isn't asserted as truth). The recall MCP tool Description gained the same steering clause behind a `| USAGE:` separator, so Codex (which has no SessionStart hook) gets the signal too. 0.12.0: new `report-problem` skill bundled with the plugin — teaches the companion how to help a user file an anonymized Vornik problem report (bug, crash, misbehaving swarm, or INSTALL failure) as a prefilled github.com/grinco/vornik issue, throughout the product lifecycle. The heavy lifting is the deterministic `vornikctl report` CLI (daemon-up rich diagnostics, `--offline` static checks, `--dry-run`/`--url-only`), plus the quickstart.sh installer's own EXIT-trap failure URL for pre-daemon install errors. The skill is the guardrail: review-the-anonymized-body-before-submit, zero-auth (user files under their own GitHub identity, nothing auto-posted), and the support-bundle attachment caveat. Two-tier anonymization (secret redaction + a public scrubber stripping emails / whole home+tilde paths / all IPv4 / this host's name) with fail-closed semantics. 0.13.0: delegate guidance corrected for the T-8f69 staging fix (2026-07-25). The daemon now DERIVES skip_auto_extract from a workflow's require_input_artifacts — on both the companion delegate and the REST create-task path — so a plain delegate() carrying inputArtifacts to companion-architectural-review / companion-doc-review / companion-rag-ingest is safe: the raw file is staged for the agent instead of being auto-extracted into RAG at upload time, and the client no longer has to remember the flag. Previously these docs never mentioned skip_auto_extract at all, so an artifact-bearing review delegated without it got inputExtractions stamped on the task, which SUPPRESSED file staging; the reviewer role (allowedTools is builtins-only, no document_* MCP tools) then hit 403 FORBIDDEN 17 times and reviewed 6 partial RAG chunks instead of the attached document. /upload keeps its explicit skip_auto_extract=True — never downgraded, and still correct against an older daemon.
